results=[]
for path,name,old,new,test in cases:
 p=Path(path);original=p.read_text()
 try:
  assert original.count(old)==1,(name,original.count(old));p.write_text(original.replace(old,new))
  run=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/python3.11','-B','-m','unittest',test],capture_output=True,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'));assert run.returncode!=0,name
  results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'exit_code':run.returncode})
 finally:p.write_text(original)
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()));from tests import test_gmyhf_graph_and_swap as tests
original=tests.wide_cpp_source()
for name,old,new in [('线段查询漏一格','query(i-k+1,i+k)','query(i-k+1,i+k-1)'),('优先选择最小位置','priority_queue<int> heap;','priority_queue<int,vector<int>,greater<int>> heap;')]:
 assert original.count(old)==1
 with patch.object(tests,'wide_cpp_source',return_value=original.replace(old,new)):
  run=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(tests.GraphAndSwapTests('test_cpp_swap_matches_all_reachable_permutations'));assert not run.wasSuccessful(),name
 results.append({'mutation':name,'detected':True,'failures':len(run.failures),'errors':len(run.errors)})
proof=json.loads(Path('collab/gmyhf-30172-authored-admin-review.json').read_text())['entries'][0]['authored_reference'];source=proof['source'];old='min(v for value,v in choices if value==score)';assert source.count(old)==1;tree=ast.parse(source.replace(old,'max(v for value,v in choices if value==score)'));tree.body=[v for v in tree.body if isinstance(v,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom,ast.FunctionDef))];ns={};exec(compile(tree,'<自产参考变异>','exec'),ns)
with patch.object(tests,'reference',return_value=ns[proof['function']]):
 run=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(tests.GraphAndSwapTests('test_story_reference_matches_all_small_dag_paths_and_cycle_rules'));assert not run.wasSuccessful()
results.append({'mutation':'同分路径错误取最大字典序','detected':True,'failures':len(run.failures),'errors':len(run.errors)})
proof=json.loads(Path('collab/gmyhf-19962-authored-admin-review.json').read_text())['entries'][0]['authored_reference'];source=proof['source'];assert source.count('len(a)//2+1')==1;tree=ast.parse(source.replace('len(a)//2+1','1'));tree.body=[v for v in tree.body if isinstance(v,(ast.Import,ast.ImportFrom,ast.FunctionDef))];ns={};exec(compile(tree,'<自产参考变异>','exec'),ns)
with patch.object(tests,'reference',return_value=ns[proof['function']]):
 run=unittest.TextTestRunner(stream=io.StringIO()).run(tests.GraphAndSwapTests('test_parcel_reference_matches_all_candidate_locations'));assert not run.wasSuccessful()
results.append({'mutation':'用最小坐标错误替代中位点','detected':True,'failures':len(run.failures),'errors':len(run.errors)})
s=Path(__file__).read_text();Path('collab/gmyhf-review-fixes-batch20-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'batch':20,'results':results,'procedure_source':s,'procedure_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest()},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(len(results),'种变异检出并恢复源码')
